historicalScope: Original unbranded design interpretations for a circa-2000 Japanese summer balcony/utility area. Dimensions and manufacturing details are modeling assumptions, not certified engineering data or exact historical SKU replicas.

assets.manufacture: Assumed molded EVA/PVC-like open-toe balcony slides. The pair is authored as soles, bridge straps, strap anchors, heel lips and real raised tread pods rather than a single primitive.
assets.mounting: Free-standing pair; every asset level is normalized to the lowest bearing point at y=0.
assets.interfaces: Bridge straps overlap molded anchor volumes. The pair is independent and not fused together. No foot deformation or wear simulation.
assets.orientationExposure: Ordinary dry balcony storage/use. Upper strap and sole edges receive sun/sky; tread is sheltered/contact-facing.
assets.agingCausality: No arbitrary mud, discoloration, disaster cue or baked contact shadow. Wear/polish must follow later placement and usage history.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Sole thickness, straps, anchors, heel lips and tread pods are geometry. Fine foam/molding grain is material.

assets.manufacture: Assumed press-formed thin steel basin with opaque enamel coating and a physically raised rolled rim accent. The coating is treated optically as a dielectric rather than bare metal.
assets.mounting: Free-standing on three shallow base feet, lowest bearing point y=0.
assets.interfaces: Outer and inner bowl skins are a single closed shell. Raised rim accent is a separate closed surface seated around the lip.
assets.orientationExposure: Open top exposed to sun/sky and dust; underside and base feet sheltered.
assets.agingCausality: Dry intact maintained state. No enamel chips, rust, water rings or soap residue until scene history supports them.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Bowl wall thickness, lip and feet are geometry. Enamel gloss/microorange-peel is material.

assets.manufacture: Assumed shallow stamped steel tray with raised centre hub and support tabs. Separate dry compressed-fibre spiral coil is supported above the tray; no smoke, ember, ash or ignition is baked into geometry/materials.
assets.mounting: Free-standing tray at y=0, static unlit coil pose.
assets.interfaces: Coil clears the tray and rests near the support hub/fork. Exhaustive contact mechanics and ash fall are not verified.
assets.orientationExposure: Tray top and coil are open to exterior air; underside sheltered.
assets.agingCausality: Unlit dry reference with intact steel and clean plant-fibre coil. Oxidation/ash/smoke staining require later causal state.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Stamped tray, hub, support tabs/fork and round spiral cross-section are geometry. Fine steel and fibre granularity is material.

materials.microstructure: subtle molded-foam/base-color and roughness variation only

materials.angularResponse: dielectric coated-surface response; no bare steel claim

materials.microstructure: fine steel roughness proxy; no baked reflection

lodPolicy: MASTER and LOD0/1/2/3 are separate exports. All principal manufactured components remain present while angular/path sampling and tread count reduce. No Unity LODGroup execution claim.

externalVerification.diagnosticPreview: actual mesh geometry only, non-Unity, no Visual Fidelity points
